verdict.rationale: All three distribution channels in the story are documented. The set is in Claude Code's official marketplace and also offers Codex/Copilot marketplace installs, all of which auto-update. Alternatively, `npx skills add` writes editable skill files into the repo as ordinary files you own, which a runtime probe confirmed by installing the tdd skill into ./.claude/skills/. missing for 10: explicit team-level guidance (e.g. committing installed skills or enabling the plugin project-wide so every teammate gets it), independent corroboration of team-scale rollout.
